looseEnds.title: Rows lost their overflow control
looseEnds.detail: The row is now a title and a timestamp and nothing else — no per-row menu, so rename, delete and view-associated-memory have no entry point from the panel. The Chat history page still draws one on every row.
looseEnds.ask: Is the panel deliberately read-only, with actions only on the full page? If so the panel needs a way to reach it, and this state has none.

looseEnds.title: No View all here, but there is one when the list is full
looseEnds.detail: This state draws four rows and no way through. The full state draws eight and a View all. Read together the rule is that the shortlist holds up to eight and only offers the page once it is at capacity — coherent, but inferred from two frames, and nothing shows what happens at five, six or seven.
looseEnds.ask: Is View all conditional on the shortlist being full, or on there being more chats than it shows?

looseEnds.title: The status bar is behind the panel in two of the three states
looseEnds.detail: Empty and Default paint the panel after the status bar, so the clock and the signal indicators vanish behind it and only the battery shows past the panel's right edge. Full paints the status bar last and keeps it. Same screen, three frames, two answers.
looseEnds.ask: Does the panel cover the status bar or sit under it? It cannot be both.

looseEnds.title: Two full-bleed scrims are stacked on the conversation
looseEnds.detail: Every frame carries Frame 2147231635 and a second layer named Scrim, both 393x852 over the conversation. Two dims at 40% compose to about 64%, which is darker than either was drawn to be.
looseEnds.ask: Is the doubling intended, or is one of these a leftover?

looseEnds.title: The panel is 330 wide here and 302 elsewhere
looseEnds.detail: Side Panel, filled recents measures 330x852. The two spare Side Panel layers inside the same frame are 302. The 28px difference changes the row width and therefore where every title truncates.
